notes.title: HOTFIX
notes.content: [p]This patch [b]fixes a crash or faulty load of a save[/b] if stats are clicked.[/p][p]I am sorry if this has happened to anyone before the fix and hope everyone can now enjoy this game peacefully![/p][p][b]Have a lovely sunday![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569868/cd3a092bf0381eaf3f9b791038a5ba7552114dda.jpg"][/img][/p]
